# #446 Börsens haverikommission

**Feed**: market-makers  
**Published**: 2026-08-27  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The Market Makers hosts set up a 'stock market accident investigation board' to go through the worst report reactions of the season: Avtech, Argo Defense, Delia, Pierce Group, Sleep Cycle and USWE, plus a note on Smart Eye's roughly 27% drop. They own none of these and are mostly waiting on the sidelines or staying away. Their positive view is on quality compounder Cheffelo, which both hosts own after a strong Q2. In a long commodities segment Fabian argues that commodities are back: he pitches refiner Calumet as a special situation from the refining shortage, and also talks about Meren Energy, thermal coal holdings, an energy ETF (XLE) and a uranium ETF.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 CHEF — Cheffelo | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Q2 EBIT +107%, EV/EBIT ~11 for 2026, good dividend; host sees ~50% upside possible over 12 months. Both hosts own it.

#### Reasoning

Host view: a quality company that keeps beating expectations. The dip after the report came from softer H2 growth guidance (tough Q3 comparison), the founder selling 10m SEK twice and a 50% YTD run. A strong NOK and rising order values should still support ~10% Q3 growth. HelloFresh has collapsed while Cheffelo keeps executing. 'Good companies keep being good.'

#### Sell Triggers

- negative growth in Q3/Q4
- HelloFresh's Nordic push hurting growth
- more large insider sales
- margin decline

> *"Kan nog ge en 50% kommande 12 månader, så jag ser inte alls som omöjligt."*

---

### 🟠 AVT-B — Avtech | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

-30% on report after LATAM cancelled software; P/E ~8 next year looks cheap, but the host has not dared to buy.

#### Reasoning

Host likes the SaaS product and wants to own it again. Valuation has fallen from P/E 13-14 to ~8 on next year's estimates. But losing a large customer raises doubts about revenue stability and whether a premium is deserved. LATAM could be a canary in the coal mine or a one-off. The co-host adds that big SaaS cancellations are usually a bad sign.

#### Sell Triggers

- more customers cancel contracts
- airline industry distress deepens
- growth keeps slowing

> *"Så jag avvaktar fortfarande Avtech men bevakar dem."*

---

### ⛔ PIERCE — Pierce Group | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

IT rollout delayed to Q1 2027, SEO traffic losses, weak European consumer, off-season ahead; host sold but sees 1-2 year potential.

#### Reasoning

Hosts see a high risk of negative surprises over the next three quarters: delays, double licence and consultant costs, traffic loss from the new country websites, and motorcycling being a summer sport. Longer term it is cheap with a net cash position and could be very cheap once the costs disappear and the economy turns, so it may be worth a look again later.

#### Sell Triggers

- reconsider if IT rollout finishes on time
- reconsider on clear cost reductions or better traffic

> *"Q3, Q4, Q1 finns det ingen anledning att ens äga den här aktien på känns det som."*

---

### 🔴 SLEEP — Sleep Cycle | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Stock at 23.90 vs Altor bid of 24.50 (~2.5% spread); very weak report risks the bid. Host would sell at market.

#### Reasoning

Revenue fell >20%, adj. EBITDA margin dropped from ~30% to <10%, net loss. Acceptance is still below 90%, and the host worries the weak report could affect the bidder. The small remaining upside is not worth that risk.

> *"Jag tror om jag hade ägt Sleepcycle så hade jag nog sålt dem till den kursen man får idag."*

---

### ⛔ USWE — USWE | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Sales -30%, negative cash flow, rising debt, stock -26%; one problem after another. Host thinks it is too risky now.

#### Reasoning

Despite running and MTB trends working in its favour, results keep disappointing. Management blames the shift from distributors to direct sales. The host doubts that leaving retail chains is wise and does not trust management's repeated promises of a turnaround. He might reconsider after the next quarter if the turnaround shows up.

#### Sell Triggers

- reconsider if direct-sales shift delivers margin and growth recovery

> *"Men jag tycker att det känns lite för läskigt just nu."*

---

### 🟢 CLMT — Calumet | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Refinery shortage drives up base oil prices; Q2 EBITDA $175m vs $76m, leverage below 4x heading under 3x; normalised target $70-90 vs ~$50.

#### Reasoning

Fabian (owns it) says war-driven base oil windfalls pay down ~3% of debt a month, worth ~$0.80/share. The Montana renewable fuels / SAF plant adds upside. Normalised it trades at ~8x EBITDA vs a historical 8-11x. A deleveraged balance sheet points to $70 at 8x and ~$90 at 10x. Accounting losses come from emissions credits, not lack of cash. He calls it a weak company in a special situation.

#### Sell Triggers

- diesel and base oil prices normalise before debt is paid down
- renewable fuels ramp disappoints
- US blending requirements cut

> *"Så det är rätt intressant om man vill exponera sig något typ av raffinaderi, lite special sits situation."*

---

### 🟢 MER — Meren Energy | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

EBITDA guidance +30%, 3x EBITDA, 10% yield, drilling restarts 2027, free option on the Venus field with fiscal terms expected in 2026.

#### Reasoning

Fabian owns it. You are paid to wait: cheap valuation, 0.5x net debt/EBITDA, 10% yield. Old below-market oil contracts are rolling off, a new gas deal has started and two rigs are due before year-end. The Venus field in Namibia is carried by TotalEnergies until first oil. Namibian fiscal terms are a near-term trigger. Free cash flow of 8-12% from 2028 at $80-100 oil.

#### Sell Triggers

- oil price collapses
- Namibia fiscal terms delayed or unfavourable
- production fails to stabilise

> *"Så du får rätt bra betalt för att vänta på att det rampar så länge inte olja faller genom golvet."*

---

### 🟠 CNR — Core Natural Resources | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Metallurgical coal prices rising, which opens up US met coal names Fabian previously passed on.

#### Reasoning

Fabian says the old favourite could be interesting for anyone adding coal exposure now that metallurgical coal, which is tied to the economy, is also rising.

#### Sell Triggers

- metallurgical coal prices reverse
- economy weakens

> *"kan vara intressanta att scopa upp om man vill öka sin kolposition"*

---

### 🟢 XLE — Energy Select Sector SPDR | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Fifth straight month of US energy ETF outflows, the largest since April 2025; Fabian bought a small contrarian position.

#### Reasoning

Contrarian bet that nobody wants to own oil even though prices are range-bound, not collapsing. It is a small, half-joking position.

#### Sell Triggers

- oil breaks down
- outflows continue

> *"Så jag har faktiskt köpt en skvätt av den här ETFen XLE"*

---

### 🟢 URNJ — Sprott Junior Uranium Miners ETF | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Uranium has lagged the commodity rally; Fabian bought the ETF as a catch-up trade. Co-host sees strong long-term nuclear demand.

#### Reasoning

Commodities are rallying broadly and uranium lagged until the last week. Nuclear build-out, including tech giants' data centres, supports demand. The ETF avoids picking individual 'bad' miners. Regulation makes timing uncertain.

#### Sell Triggers

- regulatory delays push nuclear build-out further out
- uranium price falls

> *"Därför har jag köpt lite Sprott Junger Uranium Miners, alltså en ETF, som en catch up trade."*

---

### 🟡 TER — TerraCom | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Fabian still holds thermal coal; European gas at post-Hormuz highs is reviving coal, and it trades at single-digit cash flow multiples.

#### Reasoning

High gas prices and emerging markets turning back to coal support thermal coal names. Fabian is near break-even on his coal bag and is staying in.

#### Sell Triggers

- gas prices normalise
- Hormuz disruption resolved

> *"Jag sitter ju kvar på min påse med termiskt kol."*

---

### 🟡 NHC — New Hope | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Part of Fabian's thermal coal position, supported by high gas prices; single-digit cash flow multiple.

#### Reasoning

Same thermal coal thesis as his other coal holdings: the gas squeeze pushes demand toward coal.

#### Sell Triggers

- gas prices normalise

> *"Jag sitter ju kvar på min påse med termiskt kol."*

---

### 🟡 TGA — Thungela | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

South African thermal coal holding; coal names reviving on high European gas prices.

#### Reasoning

Same thermal coal thesis as his other coal holdings; cheap on cash flow.

#### Sell Triggers

- gas prices normalise

> *"Jag sitter ju kvar på min påse med termiskt kol."*
